claims.claim: John of Damascus was a Christian monk, priest, hymnographer, and apologist.
John of Damascus was born and raised in Damascus c. AD 675 or AD 676.
John of Damascus died on 4 December AD 749 at his monastery, Mar Saba, near Jerusalem.
The Catholic Church regards John of Damascus as a Doctor of the Church.
John of Damascus was declared a doctor of the church by Pope Leo XIII in 1890.
John of Damascus's theological synthesis made him a preeminent intermediary between Greek and medieval Latin culture.
John of Damascus became a monk at Mar Saba near Jerusalem shortly after 730.
